grader.scenario: Commercial cafe guest Wi-Fi DHCP pool exhaustion resolved via subnet expansion and lease timer reduction
grader.notes: Flawless commercial technical support call demonstrating active listening, full empathy in the middle third, excellent rapport, and thorough resolution verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net commercial broadband support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Lucas throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the intense stress and financial pressure this is causing during your morning peak rush, Lucas...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased guest Wi-Fi DHCP pool issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of commercial account reference at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent expanded DHCP pool, shortened lease timer, cleared cache, and configured utilization alerts.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, supportive, and highly technical professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed effectively regarding private LAN stability, subnet parameters, and test connection outcomes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer tested iPad connection, verified captive portal, verified speed test at 85 Mbps, and confirmed patron laptops connected.
